Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental error in its initial analysis and hypothesis. It incorrectly assumed that the color orange is the *only* or *primary* national color for the Netherlands, stating, "The color is typically orange... We will verify this." This is factually incorrect; the national colors of the Netherlands are red, white, and blue. While orange is the color of the Royal House (Orange-Nassau) and the dominant color for Koningsdag celebrations, it is not the national flag color. By starting with this false premise, the Planner biased the entire search strategy, leading the WebSurfer to ignore relevant information about the actual national colors (red, white, blue) which are also worn (often in flags or clothing alongside orange), and instead focused exclusively on finding confirmation for orange as the sole answer. This initial hallucination of the national colors caused the subsequent search plan to be incomplete and potentially misleading.
